'''William Maurice Bugg''' (January 23, 1931 – February 19, 2026) was an American physicist.

== Early life and career ==
Bugg was born in [[St. Louis]], Missouri on January 23, 1931, the son of Maurice Ancel Bugg and Abbie Ruth. He attended Oak Ridge High School, graduating in 1948. After graduating, he attended [[Washington University in St. Louis]], earning his [[undergraduate degree]] in 1952, which after earning his degree, he served as an instructor at the [[Anti-aircraft warfare|Antiaircraft]] and Guide Missile School in [[Fort Bliss]]. After his discharge, he attended the [[University of Tennessee]], earning his [[Doctor of Philosophy|PhD degree]] in physics 1959.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=https://www.knoxnews.com/obituaries/pokr1417639|title=William Maurice (Bill) Bugg|work=[[Knoxville News Sentinel]]|date=February 26, 2026|access-date=March 19, 2026}}</ref>

Bugg served as a professor in the department of physics at the University of Tennessee from 1968 to 1996.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.rosefuneraltn.com/obituaries/william-bugg-3/#!/Obituary|title=William Maurice (Bill) Bugg|work=Rose Funeral and Cremation|access-date=March 19, 2026}}</ref> During his years as a professor, in 1974, he was elected as a [[List of fellows of the American Physical Society|fellow]] of the [[American Physical Society]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.aps.org/funding-recognition/winners?q=william%20bugg&af=false|title=APS Fellow Archive|work=[[American Physical Society]]|access-date=March 19, 2026}}</ref>

== Personal life and death ==
Bugg was married to Marian Sly. Their marriage lasted until her death in 2008.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.legacy.com/us/obituaries/knoxnews/name/marian-bugg-obituary?id=16817505|title=Marian Bugg Obituary (1930-2008)|work=[[Knoxville News Sentinel]]|date=September 30, 2008|access-date=March 19, 2026|via=[[Legacy.com]]}}</ref>

Bugg died in [[Knoxville, Tennessee]] on February 19, 2026, at the age of 95.<ref name=":0" />
